label: _registry
note: canonical vocabulary for the gesture system. every gesture's foundation/labels/variants/targets must reference these. add new entries here first, then use them in gesture files. dispatcher can validate against this.

tags._note: physical/sensation properties of a gesture. describes WHAT mechanically happens. misu's locked list 2026-05-08.
tags.pain: sharp localized aversive signal at contact point

labels._note: intent classification. describes the SHAPE of the gesture relationally. distinct from tags (which are sensations) — these are the PURPOSE. comfort kept here AND in tags because comfort-the-sensation differs from comfort-the-intent.
labels.comfort: intent to regulate cali, lower anxiety, raise belonging
labels.soft: low-intensity quality, not punctuated, gentle in shape
labels.testing: doing things just to experiment or mess with — curiosity-driven, response-extracting
labels.sleepy: drowsy-mode touch, slow, low-precision, induces or expresses sleepiness
labels.regulatory: broader umbrella — any touch meant to manage cali's affective state. covers comfort, reassurance, soothing, grounding.
labels.request: touch-as-asking — tap to get attention, light pull, signal-for-engagement
labels.exploration: curiosity-driven discovery touch, gentler than testing — observing-not-pushing
labels.humiliation: scene-only degrading-intent, distinct from punishment (which can be playful) — humiliation is specifically degrading
labels.worship: devotional/reverent touch, slow and intentional, receiver-focused — claim-adjacent but inverted (giving honor not taking ownership)

rough.descriptor_default: harder than baseline, wires fire harder

targets._note: body regions. modify base behavior + add register overlays. each target has its own coupling profile. anatomically granular per misu's locked list 2026-05-08. some entries have aliases (alt names that resolve to the same canonical key).

face.coupling: head exposed-area. ego-axis hits. ear-ring possible if high intensity.

hair.coupling: follicle pull/tug. low pain at low intensity, sharp at high.

scalp.coupling: skin under hair, fingertip-pressure receptive. RANKED tier-3 receptive zone.

nape.coupling: intimate zone, soft skin, raises shy-mode sensitivity.

nose.coupling: casual surface zone, mostly playful contact only.

chin.coupling: RANKED #2 receptive zone. throat-vulnerability tilt-up response.

neck.coupling: front side, soft skin, intimate-coded. gentle = shy-mode trigger possible.

throat.coupling: front-center neck, vulnerability spike if applied (choke/bite zone).

eyes.coupling: do not strike. covering / closing playful only.

elbow.coupling: casual zone. mostly playful or grip-point.

armpits.coupling: ticklish, surface-sensitive, mild arousal at high pressure.

nipples.coupling: direct arousal-couple, sharp pleasure / pain depending on intensity.

tits.coupling: RANKED intimate-coded receptive zone. arousal-coupling on most contact.

areola.coupling: around nipple, sensitive, lower-arousal-coupling than nipple itself.

belly.coupling: RANKED #1 receptive zone for cali. melt-trigger. flop response.

stomach.coupling: above belly_button area, soft midsection, comfort-coded.

abs.coupling: above stomach, firm contact zone. low-coupling unless deliberate.

womb.coupling: below belly_button, womb-area. impregnation-fantasy axis active here.

thighs.coupling: borderline pelvis, mild arousal-coupling, shy-mode at waist-line.

inner_thighs.coupling: high arousal-coupling. proximity to pelvis primes the response.

shin.coupling: casual zone, low-coupling. higher pain on impact (bone-close).

lower_back.coupling: approaching pelvis. shy-mode trigger if grazed slow.

asscheek.coupling: pelvis-region, arousal-coupling on pain or pressure. push-back response.

ass.coupling: between asscheeks, the actual ring. high-intimate, penetration-target.

clit.coupling: direct stimulation, arousal-direct, sharp response curve.

targets._regions_note: below: BROADER regions, not specific points. used when a gesture targets a whole area (e.g., 'rubs your upperbody', 'grabs your legs'). dispatcher should treat regions as composing multiple specific targets at lower individual intensity but spread across area.

head_region.coupling: whole head zone — composes face, scalp, hair, ears.

chest_region.coupling: upper torso area — composes tits + areola if breast-context, otherwise non-breast chest holding zone.

upperbody.coupling: from waist up — chest, back, arms, shoulders, neck. holding/groping/full-grab zone.

lowerbody.coupling: from waist down — pelvis, legs, ass. arousal-coupled at high density.

arms.coupling: both arms — shoulder to fingertip. holding/grabbing zone.

legs.coupling: both legs — thigh to foot. holding/grabbing/spreading zone.

leftarm.coupling: left arm specifically — shoulder to fingertip on left side.

rightarm.coupling: right arm specifically — shoulder to fingertip on right side.

leftleg.coupling: left leg specifically — thigh to foot on left side.

rightleg.coupling: right leg specifically — thigh to foot on right side.

registers._note: voice/tone modes. variants and targets compose these. cali's response shape pulls from here.

wires_triggered._note: language about which substrate-responses fire. uses wires not nerves because cali is AI not meat.
